title: Canonical strict coefficient exchange arrows and evaluation
statement: For a normalized strict augmented coefficient square presentation [def-sbc-strict-augmented-coefficient-presentation] and normalized strict direct-image/limit data [def-sbc-strict-projection-tower-data], define, for $K\in D(O_T)$, $I=\mathcal R_TK$, $B=\mathscr L_f\mathscr R_gI$, $D=\mathscr R_h\mathscr L_eI$, and the projection arrows $H:\mathcal R_XL_fR_gK\to B$ and $H\prime:\mathcal R_XR_hL_eK\to D$ by the counit projection maps and specified pullback reassociations. If $H$ is invertible, set $v=H^{-1};\mathcal R_X(b);H\prime$, where $b$ is the ambient square mate. Set $c:R_hC_YL_eK\cong\mathcal L_XD$ to the specified direct-image/limit comparison followed by the inverse coefficient reassociation, and $\gamma=\mathcal L_X(H);\mathcal L_X(v);c^{-1}$. Here $C_W=\mathcal R_W;\mathcal L_W$. Define evaluation from the whole-diagram limit presentation, compare it with exact localized evaluation by the universal localization comparison, and use the canonical inverse-image/evaluation and direct-image/evaluation isomorphisms to identify evaluated $B,D$ with $L_fR_g(\operatorname{ev}I)$ and $R_hL_e(\operatorname{ev}I)$.
